sentences.en: Mina sees eleven cats.
Eleven cats are in the neighborhood.
Not one is Nino.
Thirteen people are in the park.
She sees thirteen people.
Fourteen boys play football.
The fourteen boys run.
Fifteen girls dance.
She sees fifteen girls.
Sixteen houses are on the street.
She looks at sixteen houses.
sentences.fa: او به شانزده خانه نگاه می‌کند.

sentences.en: Seventeen birds are in the park.
She sees seventeen birds.
Eighteen windows are in the building.
The building has eighteen windows.
Nineteen people are in the cafe.
She sees nineteen people.
Twenty days without Nino feel very long to Mina.
sentences.fa: بیست روز بدون نینو برای مینا خیلی طولانی به نظر می‌رسد.

sentences.en: Twenty days, and Nino is not home.
sentences.fa: بیست روز، و نینو خانه نیست.

sentences.en: Thirty people live in the building.
sentences.fa: سی نفر در ساختمان زندگی می‌کنند.

sentences.en: Mina asks thirty people if they have seen Nino.
sentences.fa: مینا از سی نفر می‌پرسد آیا نینو را دیده‌اند.

sentences.en: A football game in the park lasts forty minutes.
sentences.fa: یک بازی فوتبال در پارک چهل دقیقه طول می‌کشد.

sentences.en: Forty minutes pass while Mina keeps looking.
sentences.fa: چهل دقیقه می‌گذرد و مینا همچنان می‌گردد.

sentences.en: Fifty houses are in the neighborhood.
She looks at fifty houses.
sentences.fa: او به پنجاه خانه نگاه می‌کند.

sentences.en: Sixty minutes make one hour.
sentences.fa: شصت دقیقه یک ساعت را می‌سازند.

sentences.en: An hour has sixty minutes.
Seventy cats are in the city.
She sees seventy cats.
Eighty people are in the restaurant.
Eighty people fill the restaurant at lunch.
sentences.fa: هنگام ناهار، هشتاد نفر رستوران را پر می‌کنند.

sentences.en: Ninety windows are in the building.
The big building has ninety windows.
A hundred people are in the park.
She sees a hundred people.
A thousand cats are in the city.
A thousand cats could be in the city, but not one is Nino.
sentences.fa: ممکن است هزار گربه در شهر باشند، اما حتی یکی از آن‌ها نینو نیست.

sentences.en: A million people are in the city.
sentences.fa: یک میلیون نفر در شهر هستند.

sentences.en: The city has a million people.
"Wait one second," Mina says when she sees something black.
sentences.fa: وقتی مینا چیزی سیاه می‌بیند، می‌گوید: «یک ثانیه صبر کن.»

sentences.en: One second, please.
Wait a moment.
A moment, please.
A week is a period of seven days.
sentences.fa: یک هفته دوره‌ی هفت روز است.

sentences.en: A month is a longer period, and Mina feels every day of it.
sentences.fa: یک ماه دوره‌ی طولانی‌تری است و مینا تک‌تک روزهایش را حس می‌کند.

check.q: در شهر چند گربه وجود دارد؟
